tip: After se for a future possibility, Portuguese uses the future subjunctive quiserem, while English just keeps the plain present want.
Que plus a subjunctive is a third-person command or wish: que se inscreva means let them register, or they should register.
Cujo means whose and agrees with the thing owned, not the owner: cujo is masculine here because faturamento is masculine.
Herdara is the simple pluperfect: one word for had inherited. The -ara ending marks it, and it is mostly literary now.
Refiro needs the preposition a (referir-se a), so the relative takes it too, and a plus a qual contracts to à qual.
